verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills is a packaging/format for capabilities (SKILL.md files, plugins, marketplaces) consumed by Claude/Claude Code, not a service or agent that itself exposes an official MCP server endpoint for other agents to connect to. Evidence mentions plugins can *bundle* MCP servers as one of several extension types, but this is about extending Claude Code, not Skills serving as an MCP server itself — the axis is a category mismatch for this product type.
